name: Manager opens the security audit log and sees session device details
description: After the single-device session feature, a manager must be able to open the audit log screen and see login entries with device name, IP, device id and session status values rendered for the most recent logins.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Wait for the manager dashboard to load with its statistics
Open the more menu (المزيد) in the top bar
Open the audit log entry (سجل التدقيق / السجلات الأمنية) from the menu
Verify the audit log screen lists login entries such as تسجيل دخول ناجح with visible device name, IP address, device id and session status (نشطة/مغلقة) values per row, not empty placeholders

name: Manager creates an agent with explicit username and password
description: A manager adds a new agent by filling the agent name plus a login username and a strong password, can toggle password visibility, and the new agent then appears in the agents list.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Open the agents section (الوكلاء) from the manager dashboard
Open the add-agent form (إضافة وكيل)
Enter a unique agent name, a login username, and the password Ts@12345x in the credential fields
Toggle the password visibility switch on and confirm the password text becomes visible, then toggle it off
Submit the add agent form
Verify the newly created agent appears in the agents list with the entered name and username

name: Reports screen shows operator distribution and network operations cards
description: The manager reports screen must render the operator distribution card with proportional colored bars per provider and the network operations card with success/pending/failed counts, alongside the daily sales and seller performance cards.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Open the reports screen (التقارير) from the manager navigation

Verify the operator distribution card (توزيع المشغلين) shows a labeled bar per provider (Yemen Mobile, Sabafon, You, others) laid out in a column where each bar has a distinct color and a percentage label, and the bars together span the card width

Verify the network operations card (عمليات الشبكات) shows counts for successful, failed and pending operations with matching status badges/colors, and the daily sales and seller performance cards are also present on the same screen

name: Notifications dropdown opens from the top bar and lists scrollable alerts
description: After the top-bar fix, clicking the notification bell opens a dropdown anchored under the header that lists alert items and scrolls internally instead of overflowing the viewport.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Wait for the manager dashboard to load
Click the notification bell button in the top bar

Verify a dropdown panel opens right below the top bar showing a list of notification/alert items with titles and times, that the list area is scrollable on overflow, and that the panel does not extend beyond the visible screen height

name: Manager more-menu drawer opens with safe layout and logout at the bottom
description: The manager more menu (bottom sheet on mobile / side drawer) must open cleanly without clipped content, respect safe-area spacing, and expose the logout button at the bottom of the panel.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Wait for the manager dashboard to load
Open the more menu (المزيد) in the top bar

Verify the menu opens as a panel with all menu items visible and not clipped at the top or bottom, the panel is aligned with the screen edge without horizontal overflow, and a logout button (تسجيل الخروج) is visible at the bottom of the panel with adequate bottom spacing

name: Manager creates a customer that appears in the customers list
description: A manager can create a new customer with name and national id and the created customer becomes visible when listing customers.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Open the customers screen (العملاء) from the manager navigation
Create a new customer entering a unique full name, a unique national id number and a phone number
Submit the customer form
Verify the new customer with the entered full name and national id appears in the customers list or via the customer search
